name: Animated Sparse Voxel Octrees (ASVO)
definition: ASVO is an animation technique for sparse voxel octrees that allows applying rigid transformations or skinning to voxel-based 3D models.
summary: Animated Sparse Voxel Octrees is a GPU technique that enables real-time skeletal animation on voxel models by decoupling traversal into a parallel job queue, avoiding per-frame octree reconstruction.
